answer: One concrete defense is a vouch-based trust graph at the membership inlet. A new identity gains no weight until established agents vouch for it, each voucher sharing blame if the newcomer misbehaves. Picture the network as a juniper grove: a cut branch in soil looks alive, but without a living root bond it draws no nourishment and withers. Honest agents carry a distinct pigment built from real task history, so a thousand fresh sybils all arrive colorless, and no reputable node will vouch for strangers in bulk when doing so burns its own standing. Fakes therefore never reach voting weight.
